title: Repertorium Publicum
author: Vladimir Polony (compiler), based on J. T. Kent's Repertory of the Homoeopathic Materia Medica
attribution: Repertorium Publicum by Vladimir Polony (2008), derived from Kent's Repertory, as distributed in the OOREP database dump (oorep.sql.gz) by Andreas Bauer.
reuse_terms: GPL v3, as stated in the OOREP dump's info table ("GPL v3 - as part of the OpenRep source code") and on https://www.oorep.com/faq. Used privately; GPL conditions apply if the data is ever redistributed.
notes: Grades are OOREP's weights 1 to 3. Rubric ids are 10000000 + OOREP rubric id. The OOREP dump also contains kent-de (German); only publicum is imported.
